title: Error mitigation extends the computational reach of a noisy quantum processor
problem_summary: Extends VQE accuracy on noisy superconducting hardware via error mitigation: extrapolating results from a series of experiments run at deliberately varied noise levels, without requiring additional hardware, demonstrated on a hardware-efficient-ansatz VQE.

components.family_or_name: zero-noise extrapolation across a series of deliberately-varied-noise experiments

components.notes: Same research group and ansatz family as kandala2017, extended here with error mitigation.

workflow_composition_notes: Standard hardware-efficient-ansatz VQE loop augmented with a post-processing error-mitigation stage that extrapolates the noise-free result from multiple noise-scaled experiments.
